header.title: Visual Concept‑Driven Image Generation
header.tagline: Personalizing text‑to‑image diffusion models with multiple interacting concepts.
header.paper: Visual Concept‑driven Image Generation with Text‑to‑Image Diffusion Model

left: Modern diffusion models can generate high‑quality images from text, but they struggle when you want several user‑specific concepts in the same scene.
This work introduces a visual concept‑driven personalization framework that learns separate concepts from a few example images and composes them in new scenes using text prompts.
blocks.rightPlaceholder: Hero illustration: input photo on the left, grid of multi‑concept generations on the right.

blocks.text: Personalization methods usually learn one concept at a time and often fail when multiple concepts must appear together and interact naturally.

items: Handling concepts that share one training image, such as a person and their background.
Combining concepts learned from different images into one coherent scene.
Maintaining identity and style for up to three concepts across many generations.
